title: d_r as a SOLO one-term correction, and the logit coordinate system — post-hoc transforms of stored predictions, no training

arms.A0: no correction — p as the model produced it
arms.A1: p + beta_s*d_s, d_s at k=400 x league  (= exp_024 arm B = candidate J's d).  CONTROL and reproduction gate
arms.A2: p + beta_r*d_r, d_r at k=400 x league.  MAIN: same k, same backoff target, same one-term structure as A1 — only the axis differs
arms.A3: p + beta_r*d_r, d_r at k=65 x league.  TWO things differ from A1, so compared against A2 only
arms.B1: sigmoid(logit(p) + gamma_s*d_s), d_s at k=400 x league.  A1's logit twin: B1 - A1 is the coordinate swap
arms.B2: sigmoid(logit(p) + gamma_r*d_r), d_r at k=400 x league.  A2's twin
arms.B3: as B1 but gamma read off an explicit block grid rather than the bounded minimiser; the whole curve is stored

changed_vs_exp_026: d_r enters as a ONE-TERM correction (p + beta_r*d_r); exp_026 only ever fitted it jointly with d_s
the reverse-axis k grid is swept over 9 values x 2 backoff targets (exp_026 had two k values, league only)
the logit coordinate system is applied for the first time (offset.apply_logit / fit_gamma existed but had never been run in an arm)
an explicit gamma grid with a stored curve and a quadratic-fit residual (B3)
the distribution of p and the linear/logit divergence at matched calibration are measured as a precondition, before any arm is scored
A0 (no correction) is an explicit arm and a second gate
unchanged_vs_exp_026: base vectors and their sha256, exp_004 F-mask, clip 1e-6, supply blocks 2022+2023, closed-form no-intercept slope for linear arms, backoff.py / dev_k.py / devgen.py / offset.py / features_platoon.py / labels.py / exp016_ref.py byte-identical (sha asserted)

reverse_table_inheritance_check.what: the reverse tables are rebuilt by the byte-preserved devgen.py; their per-season sd and league cell values are compared to the numbers exp_026 recorded, so 'inherited' is verified, not assumed

reproduction_gate.source: exp_024/metrics.json per_seed[seed].B_candidate.brier and .base_no_offset.fold_2024_brier — READ from the record, not transcribed
reproduction_gate.on_fail: abort — the reused vectors or the inherited code are not exp_024's and nothing downstream is readable

label_isolation_check.note: no model is fitted here, so the design matrix is exp_024's; check (b) below is the operative one for this experiment

asof_independent_recheck.method: row_id -> season re-read from train.csv in a SECOND pass; the max season of the CONTRIBUTING ROW IDS is looked up in that independent map, not in the frame the tables were built from

fold_2024.note: v = p(1-p) is the local slope dp/dz of the logit map.  If its coefficient of variation is small, sigmoid(logit(p)+g*d) is approximately p + g*v_mean*d, i.e. the linear arm with beta = g*v_mean, and the two coordinate systems cannot meaningfully disagree

supply_blocks.note: v = p(1-p) is the local slope dp/dz of the logit map.  If its coefficient of variation is small, sigmoid(logit(p)+g*d) is approximately p + g*v_mean*d, i.e. the linear arm with beta = g*v_mean, and the two coordinate systems cannot meaningfully disagree

coordinate_divergence.what: the linear arm at its fitted beta vs the logit arm at gamma = beta/mean(p(1-p)), which is the first-order match of the two maps.  What is left is the ONLY thing the logit space can buy beyond a rescaling of beta

adoption.rule: 3 seeds agree in sign AND |mean delta| >= 3 x A1 seed std.  Not relaxed.  The paired-delta std is reported alongside as a reference number and is NOT part of the rule; changing the rule is a user decision and would have to be pre-registered and applied forward only.

selection.primary_surface: block Brier at the block-fitted coefficient (exp_023's registered surface)
selection.secondary_surface: cross-block: fit 2022 -> score 2023 and the reverse, pooled

conversion.sensitivity: brier 1e-6 = score 0.4003.  Every Brier here is full precision, so the converted numbers carry no rounding band of their own
conversion.caveat: local measurement is at iter 650 (<=2023 training); the deployed build is iter 7700 (<=2024).

leak_boundary.tables: a season-s row reads tables built on seasons <= s-1 only, for BOTH numerators; asserted at runtime inside backoff.py / dev_k.py / devgen.py and again here by an independent second read of train.csv
leak_boundary.recovered_labels: `rev` = is_rev_only + is_both is a RECOVERED label (row t+1).  It is used only as the numerator of a frozen table, never as a row-level input; group-constancy of every deviation inside (season, pitcher, batter_hand, pitcher_hand) is asserted, which a row-level leak would break
leak_boundary.coef_fit: supply blocks 2022+2023 of the same seed, on that arm's own column; no arm's beta or gamma ever sees 2024
leak_boundary.arm_choice: arms fixed by config.yaml before any 2024 number is read; the A4 grid point and B3's gamma are selected on the blocks; A1/A2/A3/B1/B2 are pre-registered contrasts
leak_boundary.design_matrix: unchanged — no deviation is ever a model feature, and no training happens in this experiment
leak_boundary.missing: no sentinel fill anywhere; L=0 and d=0 mean 'apply no correction', the behaviour without the module
